what: Happy flow: correct import of all three data files (client's original files)
data: Original Canvas files without changes.
expected: No data errors (DQ-*). Warnings DQ-ENERGY are expected: the energy values in the client's file differ from the model.

what: Missing column detected (energy consumption removed)
data: Test-BASE with column 'energy consumption' deleted.
expected: ERROR DQ-COL: 'Missing column(s): energy consumption.' No further analysis.

what: Invalid activity type detected ('brake')
data: Test-BASE, row 4 (bus 1, idle) activity changed to 'brake'.
expected: ERROR DQ-ACT on row 4: Unknown activity 'brake'.

what: Text instead of a time value detected
data: Test-BASE, row 4 start time = 'ten past six'.
expected: ERROR DQ-TIME on row 4.

what: Trip on an out-of-scope line (402) detected
data: Test-BASE, row 57 (bus 2, service trip) line changed to 402.
expected: ERROR DQ-LINE on row 57: line 402 out of scope. (Follow-on: FC8 because that timetable trip is now not driven.)

what: Empty data file (header only) handled gracefully
data: Only the header row.
expected: ERROR DQ-EMPTY 'contains no data', no crash.

what: Wrong file uploaded as bus plan (timetable)
data: Copy of Timetable.xlsx, uploaded in the bus-plan field.
expected: ERROR DQ-COL listing the missing bus-plan columns, no crash.

what: Rows not in chronological order are reported, not sorted
data: Test-BASE with the rows of bus 1 in reverse order.
expected: ERROR FC4 for bus 1: rows overlap / are in the wrong order. The tool does not change the order of the file.

what: FC1 happy flow: SOC stays within normal range
data: Test-BASE (feasible plan from the generator).
expected: FC1 PASS for all buses; plan feasible.

what: FC1 error: SOC drops far below 10% (charging removed)
data: Test-BASE, every charging session of bus 5 changed into idle.
expected: FC1 FAIL for bus 5 with time of first violation and lowest SOC.

what: FC1 boundary: lowest SOC exactly 10.0% of Q·SOH
data: Test-BASE; energy of the first activity of bus 14 (row 657) increased by 57.7320 kWh, so that the lowest SOC of bus 14 becomes 10.00%. Run with energy source = file column.
expected: Lowest SOC bus 14 = 10.00% → PASS (10.00% is allowed)

what: FC1 boundary: lowest SOC exactly 9.9% of Q·SOH
data: Test-BASE; energy of the first activity of bus 14 (row 657) increased by 57.9870 kWh, so that the lowest SOC of bus 14 becomes 9.90%. Run with energy source = file column.
expected: Lowest SOC bus 14 = 9.90% → FAIL (9.90% < 10%)

what: FC2: charging session of 20 minutes
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) set to 20 min, following idle extended. Energy values unchanged → run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC2 PASS for bus 13.

what: FC2: charging session of 5 minutes
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) set to 5 min, following idle extended. Energy values unchanged → run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC2 FAIL for bus 13.

what: FC2: charging session of 15 minutes
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) set to 15 min, following idle extended. Energy values unchanged → run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC2 PASS (15 min is allowed) for bus 13.

what: FC2: charging session of 14 minutes
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) set to 14 min, following idle extended. Energy values unchanged → run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC2 FAIL (14 < 15 min) for bus 13.

what: FC3: charging session ends at 85.0% SOC
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) starts at 13.18%; its energy set to -183.1410 kWh so it ends at 85.00%. Run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC3 PASS for bus 13.

what: FC3: charging session ends at 95.0% SOC
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) starts at 13.18%; its energy set to -208.6410 kWh so it ends at 95.00%. Run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC3 FAIL for bus 13.

what: FC3: charging session ends at 90.0% SOC
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) starts at 13.18%; its energy set to -195.8910 kWh so it ends at 90.00%. Run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC3 PASS (90.00% is allowed) for bus 13.

what: FC3: charging session ends at 90.1% SOC
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) starts at 13.18%; its energy set to -196.1460 kWh so it ends at 90.10%. Run with energy source = file column.
expected: FC3 FAIL (90.10% > 90%) for bus 13.

what: FC4 happy flow: consecutive trips, no overlap, valid service trips
data: Test-BASE.
expected: FC4 PASS.

what: FC4 error: end time of activity 1 after start time of activity 2 (overlap)
data: Test-BASE; idle of bus 1 (row 7) ends 3 min after the next service trip starts.
expected: FC4 FAIL (overlap) on row 8.

what: FC4 error: service trip not present in Timetable.xlsx
data: Test-BASE; service trip on row 14 (bus 1) departs 1 minute later than in the timetable.
expected: FC4 FAIL on row 14 (not in timetable) and FC8 FAIL (original timetable trip not driven).

what: FC4 error: material trip has a line number filled in
data: Test-BASE; material trip on row 2 gets line 400.
expected: FC4 FAIL on row 2.

what: FC4 boundary: end time of trip 1 equals start time of trip 2
data: Test-BASE; e.g. rows 8-9 (bus 1): service trip ends 06:59, next service trip starts 06:59.
expected: PASS (no overlap).

what: FC5 error: bus 'jumps' to another location
data: Test-BASE; idle on row 4 moved from ehvapt to ehvbst.
expected: FC5 FAIL on rows 4 and 5.

what: FC6 error: charging at a location without charger
data: Test-BASE; charging on row 27 at ehvbst instead of ehvgar.
expected: FC6 FAIL on row 27 (follow-on FC5 errors expected).

what: FC7 error: trip faster than the minimum travel time
data: Test-BASE; service trip on row 9 ends 5 min earlier.
expected: FC7 FAIL (error) on row 9.

what: FC8 error: timetable trip not driven
data: Test-BASE; service trip ehvbst->ehvapt 07:51 (bus 1) deleted.
expected: FC8 FAIL: trip at 07:51 not driven (follow-on FC5 because the bus stays put).

what: FC8 error: timetable trip driven twice
data: Test-BASE plus extra bus 99 that also drives the 10:26 trip ehvapt->ehvbst.
expected: FC8 FAIL: trip driven 2 times.

what: Trips after midnight are handled (no negative durations)
data: Test-BASE contains the 23:37 and 00:01 timetable trips (ending after 00:00).
expected: No DQ-DUR errors; those trips count as end of the service day.

what: KPI1 happy flow: correct count of buses used (3 buses)
data: Mini plan: 3 buses, 5 service trips, 3 charging sessions (20 + 15 + 15 min). Use timetable Test-MINI-Timetable.xlsx and SOC at start of day = 40% (so that charging stays below 90%).
expected: Buses used = 3

what: KPI1 boundary: non-consecutive bus numbers (1, 2, 5)
data: Test-MINI with bus 3 renumbered to 5.
expected: Buses used = 3 (not 5)

what: KPI2 happy flow: total charging time matches manual sum
expected: Total charging time = 20 + 15 + 15 = 50 min; charging sessions = 3

what: KPI3 happy flow: material trip distance/time matches manual calculation
data: Test-MINI material trips: 3× gar→bst (4 min, 1.65 km), 2× bst→gar (4 min, 1.65 km), 1× apt→gar (20 min, 9.0 km).
expected: Material trips = 6; time = 5×4 + 20 = 40 min; distance = 5×1.65 + 9.0 = 17.25 km

what: Energy calc: tool recalculates driving energy instead of trusting the file column
data: Test-MINI, row 3: service trip line 400 ehvbst→ehvapt, 10,708 m.
expected: Model energy = 10.708 km × 1.2 kWh/km = 12.8496 kWh

what: Energy calc: idle activity of 30 minutes
data: Test-MINI: bus 3 idle 08:23-08:53 at ehvapt.
expected: Idle energy = 5 kW × 0.5 h = 2.5 kWh (the client's file always uses 5 kWh)

what: Regression: original client plan
data: Original Canvas files.
expected: Not feasible: FC1 errors on 13 buses; FC4/FC5 errors on 6 buses where rows are in the wrong order; 20 buses, 23 charging sessions, 505 min charging, 251 material trips.

what: Generator: improved plan is feasible and covers the timetable
data: Plan made by the tool itself (tab 'Improved plan', button 'Generate improved plan') with the default assumptions.
expected: Feasible (no errors), all 327 timetable trips driven, fewer buses than the original plan (20).

what: Generator: exported file has exactly the client's format
data: Excel file downloaded with 'Download improved plan' compared with the client's Bus_Planning.xlsx.
expected: Same sheet name (Sheet1) and the same 8 column headers in the same order.

what: FC3 error: charging continues past 90% (model mode, can be run in the app)
data: Test-BASE; charging of bus 13 at 21:34 (row 652) extended from 26 to 36 minutes, following idle shortened.
expected: FC3 FAIL for bus 13 on row 652.
